_source.rules: pricing.prompt / pricing.completion per token x 1e6. Time-of-day overrides (peak vs base): the highest rate, since the ledger keeps no time of day and a higher rate never under-counts. Prompt-size overrides (min_prompt_tokens >= 32k): the base rate, a Zumi request stays far below. Output = max(completion, internal_reasoning). Price -1: unverified. Written by scripts/refresh-usage-prices.mjs.

_webSearch.source: OpenRouter docs features/web-search, read 2026-10-10: Exa engine $0.007 per request including up to 10 results (+$0.001 per extra result; Zumi asks for 5). Results also bill as prompt tokens, counted in the row's token cost.
